items.title: Colour-Sorted Wardrobe Rail: A Simple Rainbow System
items.description: Organize hanging clothes by colour from light to dark for a wardrobe that looks beautiful and makes outfits easier to find. Free and quick to do.

image.alt: Hanging rail of T-shirts and shirts arranged by colour from white to red, yellow, orange, brown and black

items.title: File-Folding Drawer Organization for Small Wardrobes
items.description: Fold T-shirts, jeans and jumpers upright in drawers so you can see everything at once. A free DIY method that saves space in small wardrobes.

image.alt: Person folding piles of jeans, striped tops and T-shirts on a bed

items.title: Neutral Capsule Wardrobe on an Open Clothes Rail
items.description: Build a calm capsule wardrobe on a freestanding clothes rail, with cosy knitwear in cream, camel and brown for autumn and winter.

image.alt: Open clothes rail with cream, camel and brown knitwear on wooden hangers beside dried pampas grass

items.title: Open White Wardrobe System with Shelves and Hanging Rail
items.description: An open white wardrobe system with adjustable shelves, a hanging rail and storage boxes. A minimalist way to see every outfit at a glance.

image.alt: Open white wardrobe system with shelves holding boxes and bags, a hanging rail with neutral clothes and a woven basket
